* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex production, performance and reliability issues in high-availability environments.

* Experience working in large-scale digital product environments with multiple delivery teams and shared platforms.
* Basic understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), its common use cases and the evolving AI market landscape.
* Ability to create and configure AI agents and reusable skills for defined engineering or business use cases.

* Demonstrated experience delivering products powered by Generative AI or machine learning, including conversational or search‑based interfaces.
* Deep understanding of user‑centered design and rapid prototyping (wireframes, prototypes, experimentation).

Our platform is already in production and scaling. This role goes beyond building UI screens or implementing predefined features. We are looking for an engineer who can independently understand complex requirements, make sound architectural decisions, solve challenging technical problems, and build a mobile application that remains **fast, reliable, maintainable, and scalable** as usage grows.

You will work closely with AI, backend, product, and design teams to integrate **LLMs, RAG pipelines, streaming AI responses, and real\-time services** into the mobile experience.

The ideal candidate combines strong Flutter expertise with a high degree of technical ownership and a problem\-solving mindset.

Key Responsibilities

* Own the **architecture, design, development, testing, and deployment** of complex mobile features using Flutter and Dart.
* Design scalable Flutter application architecture with appropriate **state management, modularization, dependency management, and reusable components**.
* Build fast, responsive mobile experiences for **real\-time AI interactions and streaming responses**.
* Integrate mobile applications with backend services through **REST APIs and streaming APIs**, with robust authentication, error handling, retries, and rate\-limit handling.
* Work closely with AI engineers to integrate **LLMs, AI APIs, RAG pipelines, AI\-powered search, and other intelligent services** into the mobile application.
* Design the mobile experience to support a growing number of **concurrent users and real\-time interactions**.
* Implement efficient **caching, offline capabilities, background processing, synchronization, and network resilience**.
* Investigate and resolve performance bottlenecks across the application, network layer, API integrations, and device resources.
* Improve application **performance, reliability, maintainability, observability, and stability**.
* Take ownership of technical problems from initial investigation and root\-cause analysis through production resolution.
* Manage **iOS and Android releases**, including build management, signing, versioning, App Store and Play Store submissions.
* Participate actively in **architecture and technology decisions** as the product and platform evolve.
* Establish and improve engineering practices around **code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, documentation, monitoring, and release management**.
* Monitor production application health and proactively identify potential scalability or reliability issues.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers when required.

Required Experience \& Skills

* **3\+ years of professional Flutter development experience**, with experience building and shipping production\-grade applications.
* Strong proficiency in **Dart and Flutter**.
* Strong understanding of modern Flutter architecture and state\-management approaches such as **BLoC, Riverpod, Provider, or equivalent patterns**.
* Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, design patterns, modularization, and maintainable code structures.
* Hands\-on experience integrating **REST APIs, authentication mechanisms, asynchronous APIs, and streaming data**.
* Experience building applications involving **real\-time interactions or high\-frequency API communication**.
* Strong understanding of mobile\-specific scalability considerations including:
* Offline\-first or intermittent\-network handling
* Local caching and persistence
* Background processing
* Network resilience and retry strategies
* Memory and resource optimization
* Application startup and rendering performance
* Experience diagnosing and resolving **production performance, stability, and reliability issues**.
* Good understanding of automated testing, including **unit, widget, and integration testing**.
* Experience with Git\-based development and modern software engineering practices.
* Ability to independently investigate unfamiliar technical problems, evaluate alternatives, and determine an appropriate implementation approach.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with **AI, backend, product, QA, and design teams**.

AI \& Real\-Time Application Experience

The mobile application will interact extensively with AI\-powered backend services. Candidates should be comfortable working with systems involving:

* **Large Language Models (LLMs)**
* **Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)**
* AI\-powered search and conversational interfaces
* Streaming AI responses
* Real\-time API interactions
* Long\-running AI requests and asynchronous workflows
* Handling latency, retries, timeouts, and partial responses
* Secure handling of user and application data

Prior AI experience is beneficial, but strong Flutter engineers who can quickly understand and integrate complex backend services are also encouraged to apply.

Mindset We Value

We are particularly interested in engineers who enjoy solving difficult technical problems and taking meaningful ownership.

You should be someone who:

* Enjoys working on **technically challenging problems**.
* Takes ownership rather than waiting for detailed implementation instructions.
* Is comfortable working with **ambiguity and evolving requirements**.
* Thinks about scalability and long\-term maintainability while building.
* Investigates the **root cause** of problems instead of relying on temporary fixes.
* Proactively identifies technical risks before they become production issues.
* Challenges existing approaches when a better solution is available.
* Can evaluate multiple technical approaches and clearly explain trade\-offs.
* Remains persistent when the first solution does not work.
* Takes responsibility for the quality and reliability of what you build.

Nice to Have

* Experience with **AWS or similar cloud\-based production environments**.
* Experience building **high\-concurrency or real\-time mobile applications**.
* Experience integrating **LLMs, GenAI APIs, or machine\-learning services** into production applications.
* Experience with **RAG, semantic search, vector search, or AI\-powered search applications**.
* Experience with WebSockets, Server\-Sent Events (SSE), or similar streaming technologies.
* Experience implementing mobile **CI/CD pipelines**.

Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non\-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

 **About the Role**



Glance operates one of the world's largest owned\-and\-operated mobile surfaces, reaching hundreds of millions of users across US, India, LATAM, Japan and Southeast Asia.



As **Director – Programmatic Monetization**, you will own the programmatic business end\-to\-end — from revenue and yield to demand partnerships, auction strategy, new monetization capabilities and the team that drives them.



This is a global leadership role with direct accountability for building the next phase of Glance's programmatic monetization engine.


**What will you be doing?**


* **Revenue \& Growth:** Own global programmatic revenue, growth strategy, annual plans and forecasts across markets.
* **Global Demand Partnerships:** Build and manage senior relationships with SSPs, exchanges and agencies, including commercial terms, strategic partnerships and supply commitments.
* **Deals \& Auction Packages:** Drive growth of PMP, PG and curated auction packages, increasing their contribution to overall programmatic revenue.
* **Programmatic Capabilities:** Define and build new auction, bidding, yield and monetization capabilities that expand what Glance can monetize.
* **Format Innovation:** Identify, develop and scale new ad formats and placements across Glance's surfaces while balancing monetization with user experience.
* **AI\-First Monetization:** Establish AI as a core operating layer for the monetization function — using AI to forecast, detect anomalies, optimize yield, automate reporting and improve decision\-making, while applying judgment on where AI adds real value.
* **Policy \& Platform Readiness:** Ensure compliance with platform, privacy and industry policies, while driving Glance's approval, onboarding and readiness across major demand platforms.
* **Industry Representation:** Represent Glance with global demand partners, industry forums and relevant advertising bodies, shaping conversations around programmatic, publisher monetization and emerging standards.
* **Team \& Organization:** Build, structure and scale the programmatic monetization organization, establishing clear ownership, operating rhythms and strong functional depth.

* **12\+ years of experience in ad tech**, with senior ownership of programmatic or publisher\-side revenue at a large publisher, SSP, exchange, app developer or similar ecosystem.
* A proven track record of **owning revenue metrics** with experience building plans, forecasts and growth strategies.
* **Deep hands\-on understanding of the programmatic stack**, including auction mechanics, bidding architecture, ad serving, measurement, identity and yield optimization. You should be able to go deep enough with engineering and partners to challenge assumptions and identify the real constraint.
* Strong **publisher\-side monetization expertise**, including pricing, yield management, demand optimization and the trade\-offs between revenue, fill, latency and user experience.
* **Leverage AI to drive efficiency and performance** — use AI models and tooling to forecast performance, identify anomalies, optimize yield, automate workflows and reduce manual reporting, while applying human judgment where it adds the most value.
* Experience operating across **multiple global markets**, with a strong understanding of how programmatic strategy, demand dynamics, pricing and user behavior differ by geography. **US market experience is a strong plus.**
* A demonstrated ability to **build, lead and level up high\-performing teams**, with experience hiring strong talent, developing leaders and creating scalable operating structures.
* Strong commercial and stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to operate effectively across **product, engineering, sales, finance, legal and external partners**.
* A strategic thinker who can move seamlessly between **long\-term business strategy and the technical details of an auction happening today**.

 **The InMobi Culture**



At InMobi, culture isn't a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.



We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.
